_description: Key numerical values from the AI-Augmented Scientific Workflow Framework v1.2 (Magnusson, DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.30636863)

ENTROPY_HIGH_THRESHOLD.description: Normalised Shannon entropy above which a landscape is deemed high-entropy

RS_PASS_THRESHOLD.description: Minimum reflective-scaffolding composite score to pass verification

SR_GATE_THRESHOLD.description: Minimum composite score for the human-validation gate to auto-pass

KL_NOVELTY_THRESHOLD.description: KL divergence (nats) above which a signal is classified as novel

roles.Human: Conceptual direction, theoretical framing, question architecture, interpretation, final validation
roles.AI: Formal drafting, symbolic structuring, documentation support, reflective scaffolding, uncertainty-driven exploration
roles.System: Version control, schema validation, build pipelines, metadata, machine-readable structure
